briefing: This is {PATRON}, calling from {HERE}. One of our survey pilots is drifting out there in an escape pod, and the air will not last.
Scoop that pod before something else does, and land her alive at any station you can reach.
Do this well, and {PATRON} will remember it long after you leave {HERE}.

pod.arrive: Scoop the pod adrift at {TARGET} and bring her home for {PAY}.
pod.success: She came in alive from {TARGET}, and {PAY} is yours.
pod.fail: She did not survive {TARGET}, and {PAY} goes unpaid.

data.arrive: Take the survey data back to {TARGET} for {PAY}.
data.success: The data reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} is paid in full.
data.fail: The data never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} is lost.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} has left word at {WORLD}, asking for a private channel.

rumour.far: Word on the board says {PATRON} at {WORLD} is short a pilot and paying well for her return.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: a survey pilot is adrift, and time is short.

dossier.news: Word from {WORLD} says {PATRON} is offering fair pay to whoever brings a stranded pilot home.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, out of {WORLD}, she took the call for a pilot adrift in a pod.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the pilot was landed alive and the job out of {WORLD} was closed clean.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the rescue died on the vine, and {WORLD} logged another life lost.

pod.survivor:landed: The pod gave up its pilot alive near {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
pod.survivor:sold: The pilot from {WORLD} was sold before day {DAY} closed, and the rescue failed.
pod.targetDestroyed: The pod was destroyed near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, and the search moved on.
pod.failed: The pod near {WORLD} was never scooped, and day {DAY} closed the chase.

data.success: The survey data reached {WORLD} safely on day {DAY}.
data.failed: The survey data never reached {WORLD}, and the trail went cold by day {DAY}.

dossier.title: Bring Her In Alive
